name: openai/wizper
description: Wizper is a fast Whisper v3 speech-to-text model. It transcribes audio or video in about 100 languages, or translates the speech into English, with segment-level timestamps.

task.title: Task
task.description: Task to perform on the audio file. Either transcribe or translate.

audio.title: Audio Url
audio.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe. Supported formats: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav or webm.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the model to use. All of the models are the Whisper large variant.

language.title: Language
language.description:
Language of the audio file.
        If translate is selected as the task, the audio will be translated to
        English, regardless of the language selected. If `None` is passed,
        the language will be automatically detected. This will also increase
        the inference time.

chunk_level.title: Chunk Level
chunk_level.description: Level of the chunks to return.

merge_chunks.title: Merge Chunks
merge_chunks.description: Whether to merge consecutive chunks. When enabled, chunks are merged if their combined duration does not exceed max_segment_len.

max_segment_len.title: Max Segment Len
max_segment_len.description: Maximum speech segment duration in seconds before splitting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Wizper (Whisper v3)

Wizper is a fast Whisper v3 speech-to-text model: transcribe audio in about 100 languages, or translate it to English.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio` | audio URL | — | Audio or video URL to transcribe. |
| `task` | `transcribe` / `translate` | `transcribe` | `transcribe` keeps the source language; `translate` outputs English. |
| `chunk_level` | string | `segment` | Timestamp granularity. |
| `max_segment_len` | integer 10–29 | 29 | Maximum segment length in seconds. |
| `language` | `af` / `am` / `ar` / `as` / `az` / `ba` / `be` / `bg` / `bn` / `bo` / `br` / `bs` / `ca` / `cs` / `cy` / `da` / `de` / `el` / `en` / `es` / `et` / `eu` / `fa` / `fi` / `fo` / `fr` / `gl` / `gu` / `ha` / `haw` / `he` / `hi` / `hr` / `ht` / `hu` / `hy` / `id` / `is` / `it` / `ja` / `jw` / `ka` / `kk` / `km` / `kn` / `ko` / `la` / `lb` / `ln` / `lo` / `lt` / `lv` / `mg` / `mi` / `mk` / `ml` / `mn` / `mr` / `ms` / `mt` / `my` / `ne` / `nl` / `nn` / `no` / `oc` / `pa` / `pl` / `ps` / `pt` / `ro` / `ru` / `sa` / `sd` / `si` / `sk` / `sl` / `sn` / `so` / `sq` / `sr` / `su` / `sv` / `sw` / `ta` / `te` / `tg` / `th` / `tk` / `tl` / `tr` / `tt` / `uk` / `ur` / `uz` / `vi` / `yi` / `yo` / `zh` | `en` | Source language code. |
| `version` | string | `3` | Version of the model to use. |
| `merge_chunks` | boolean | true | Merge short segments. |

## Billing

$0.006 per request, whatever the audio length.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One file | $0.006 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Limits

- One audio file per request.
